results.description: By altering a URL identifier, a shopper can inspect purchase histories belonging to unrelated customers.
A low-privilege operator is able to export financial documents intended exclusively for executives.
The API returns a different tenant's medical documents when the requester substitutes a tenant ID.
A visitor without an account can inspect internal personnel profiles.
Changing a document reference allows a basic user to obtain a supervisor's restricted files.
An unauthenticated caller receives another organization's invoices through a predictable endpoint.
An apostrophe in a product filter unexpectedly changes the SQL WHERE clause.
User-controlled input is inserted directly into a SELECT statement, modifying its conditions.
An attacker supplies a UNION SELECT payload and extracts additional rows from a relational datastore.
The application constructs database commands by joining raw request parameters into executable SQL.
A search box accepts a tautology payload that makes the backend return every account.
A crafted ORDER BY expression reveals that untrusted text is executed as part of a query.
A storage bucket permits anonymous listing and retrieval of customer backups.
An internet-facing management interface still accepts the vendor's original login credentials.
Detailed stack traces and environment variables are displayed to visitors on production error pages.
A deployment accidentally leaves a diagnostic endpoint accessible to everyone.
The cloud database allows connections from any IP address without network restrictions.
A publicly reachable service exposes its administrative console because access restrictions were disabled.
A security engineer tests SQL injection defenses in an approved staging environment.
An employee downloads a confidential report after receiving explicit authorization.
A developer removes factory-default credentials before deploying the server.
A database administrator executes a documented maintenance query.
A monitoring system alerts when an unauthorized request is blocked by access-control rules.
A cloud engineer disables public access to a storage bucket during a security review.
